title: Components & UT physics
problem: Correlate customer geometry, material and reflectors with authorized reference acquisitions.
result: A documented model with application-specific error limits.
inputs: CAD, materials, probe data and representative measured signals.

title: Embedded & FPGA
problem: Find where a firmware, RTOS or acquisition-chain change alters the inspection result.
result: A reproducible BSP / peripheral / RTL regression bench and agreed HIL tests.
inputs: Firmware sources or authorized binaries, register contracts and acceptance cases.

title: Advanced UT & assisted analysis
problem: Evaluate PAUT, FMC/TFM, TOFD or AI assistance for an agreed inspection task.
result: An evaluated implementation with provenance and uncertainty scope.
inputs: Authorized datasets, probe geometry, labels and independent validation data.

title: Paths, instruments & robots
problem: Maintain contact and adapt acquisition to the accessible surface.
result: A dedicated scanner or robot adapter with validated motion and data alignment.
inputs: Device SDK, geometry, safety constraints and reference trajectories.

title: Enterprise data & traceability
problem: Connect device files and inspection evidence to existing business systems.
result: A tested .nde / DICONDE / MES / QMS / PLM mapping with roundtrip evidence.
inputs: Format versions, sample files, data ownership and integration requirements.

title: Studies & training
problem: Explain an indication and quantify performance within a defensible scope.
result: Customer procedures, curated training or a validated statistical study.
inputs: Inspection procedure, authorized reference data and acceptance criteria.
